newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady ahead of FOMC.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in moderate pre-holiday trade with most traders sidelined ahead of the outcome of today's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) Meeting, dealers said on Tuesday.

"Rates were steady to slightly higher this morning on some position adjustments. Basically, everyone is waiting for more clues about monetary policy from the outcome of today's FOMC Meeting," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact as the market will closed tomorrow for the Vesak Day holiday," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from Monday's common 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, two-months rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent and four-months rose 1/16 point to 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent.
Six-months was unchanged from Monday's 6 5-7/8 percent and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/4 6-1/8 percent.
